column1: Cover the noodles with boiling water and soak 5 minutes. Drain, rinse briefly under cold water, and use within 5–10 minutes.
Stir the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large nonstick pan over high heat. Cook the garlic and onion for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook about 1 1/2 minutes until nearly done.
Push the chicken aside, pour the egg into the empty side, scramble it, then mix it in with the chicken.
Add the bean sprouts, tofu, noodles, and sauce. Toss gently about 1 1/2 minutes until the noodles soak up the sauce.
Toss in the garlic chives and half the peanuts, then take off the heat.
Serve right away topped with the rest of the peanuts, with lime wedges, chili, and extra sprouts on the side.
